not_performed: Visual review of generated example figures
integration_findings: Entrypoint skill name is paper-figure-creation; repository root is not the skill root.
Teaser, method, and benchmark/environment are conditional roles, not a mandatory set.
Benchmark/environment mode requires a described substantive setup and new/adapted/existing status.
spec-format.md supports kind=benchmark; the shorter common-envelope prose in evidence.md lists only teaser and method.
Quantitative values and claims require stable result IDs, exact source locations, units, comparability, and uncertainty provenance.
Rendered pixels at manuscript insertion size must be inspected in addition to structural validation.
